findingClass: pull-model verification check REREAD-LATENCY: oldest actionable disagreement with no re-read attempt
whatItAsks: oldest actionable disagreement with no re-read attempt
alarmsWhen: over 48 h, listed by IPO and field
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots (docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §2.1)
consumer: nightly floor-delta (Notifier post + issue on NEW)
consumerReason: a 48-hour staleness watch is naturally read once a night (each cycle re-checking it would be redundant with the 30-minute cadence) and needs a diffing consumer to compare the oldest age night over night
status: designed, not yet built — specified by docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md; build item 10 (owner decision OD-42: "a check nobody reads is no detection")
sourceDesign: docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §4 ("How we would know it worked")
note: Retired 2026-09-21: OD-65 (owner, 2026-09-21) withdrew the re-read loop this check measures: "everything should be done on day one itself, and it should not be repeated for the same IPO... one IPO, one round of document read." The loop was never built (zero `reread` hits in scraper/src), and it is now explicitly not wanted, so this check measures a population that can never become non-empty — the same shape ratios_extraction_yield was retired for on 2026-09-16. It was also mis-sized from the start: the loop was scoped from "578 leadManagers conflicts" and the real count, after removing same-source rows, null-on-one-side rows and byte-identical values, is 1 on staging and 2 on prod. Its §3.2 premise additionally contradicts OD-32, which deletes the PDF bytes the check's receipt requires (#853).
retiredBy: OD-65 (#853) — no replacement; the behaviour is withdrawn, not moved
